mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have a comfortable 63 degrees with clear skies at Badger Prairie County Park, a waning crescent moon overhead, and a quick space station pass visible at 5:13 AM appearing over Mount Horeb before heading toward Belleville.

In city news, the Verona Police Department arrested a 34-year-old Madison resident on September 4 following an investigation into a child assault case that occurred back in 2019. Additionally, road crews are moving into phase two of construction on Highway M the week of September 7, which will shift traffic patterns, while the Military Ridge State Trail will see closures from mid-September to mid-November for bridge work.

There is plenty to do, including live music today at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Lake Lou-ee, yoga tomorrow at Insight Wellness, and a full schedule of trivia nights starting Monday at Hop Haus and Lake Lou-ee.
On Sunday, August 30, the Verona Area School District alerted police to an inappropriate relationship between a teacher and a student, leading to the arrest of 34-year-old Halla Nelson.
Today's flavor is the delicious Snickers Swirl and you can visit the store when it opens today at 10:00 AM.
